SHIPPING_POLICY.TITLE: Shipping & Delivery Policy
SHIPPING_POLICY.SUBTITLE: Everything you need to know about order delivery across all Egyptian governorates

SECTION1.HEADING: Delivery Policy
SECTION1.INTRO: At Vitatrex, we strive to provide an easy and reliable shopping experience, ensuring your orders are delivered quickly and safely across Egypt.
SECTION1.SUB1_TEXT: Orders are processed and prepared for shipping within 2–3 business days from order confirmation. Orders placed during weekends or official holidays are processed on the following business day.
SECTION1.SUB2_TEXT: Delivery time varies based on customer location and courier company. Orders are delivered to the address registered during checkout.
SECTION1.SUB3_TEXT: Shipping fees are calculated according to delivery location and are clearly displayed during checkout prior to final order confirmation.
SECTION1.SUB4_TEXT: If your order is delayed beyond the expected timeframe or you encounter any delivery issue, please contact us via email at: vitatrexshop@gmail.com and we will follow up with the shipping company to assist you promptly.

SECTION2.HEADING: Shipping & Delivery Policy
SECTION2.INTRO: At Vitatrex, we ensure your orders are delivered quickly and safely while maintaining optimal product quality and safety until they reach your doorstep.
DETAILS: Cairo & Giza: Orders are delivered within 24 hours of order confirmation.
Other Governorates: Delivery takes between 24 to 72 hours, depending on customer location and the courier company.
In certain remote areas or exceptional cases, delivery may take additional time.
Order Packaging: All Vitatrex orders are prepared and carefully packaged before dispatch, ensuring the package is securely sealed and protected during transit until delivered in pristine condition.

Order Tracking: Customers receive all relevant delivery updates, and the courier may contact the customer to coordinate delivery timing. For any issues or delays, please contact us at: vitatrexshop@gmail.com
SECTION2.OUTRO: We are always delighted to serve you and committed to delivering a safe, fast, and trusted shopping experience with Vitatrex.

RETURN_POLICY.TITLE: Return & Refund Policy
RETURN_POLICY.SUBTITLE: Standards and procedures for returns and exchanges ensuring your safety and highest product quality
RETURN_POLICY.POINT1: For your safety and product quality, we are committed to providing intact and order-compliant products upon delivery.
RETURN_POLICY.POINT2: In case of receiving a damaged or non-matching product, please contact us within 48 hours of order delivery with clear photos of the product and packaging so we can review the request and take appropriate action.
RETURN_POLICY.POINT3_ALERT: Returns or exchanges are not accepted for products that have been opened or used, in order to maintain quality and safety standards.
RETURN_POLICY.POINT4: Upon approval of return or exchange, coordination will be made with the customer regarding package pickup and processing based on order status.

PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.SUBTITLE: We are committed to safeguarding your privacy and personal data when shopping at Vitatrex
PRIVACY_POLICY.STAT2_LABEL: We never sell or rent your data
PRIVACY_POLICY.INTRO: At Vitatrex, protecting our customers' privacy and data security is our utmost priority. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit and shop with us.

SECTION1.TITLE: 1. Information Collection
SECTION1.TEXT: We collect information you provide directly to us when creating an account, completing a purchase, or contacting customer support. We also automatically collect certain data via cookies and analytics tools (such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity) to optimize your browsing experience and enhance our services.
SECTION1.DIRECT_TEXT: Name, delivery address, phone number, email address, and order specifics.
SECTION1.AUTO_TEXT: Cookies, user interaction heatmaps, device and browser specifications via certified analytics tools.

SECTION2.TITLE: 2. Use of Data
SECTION2.INTRO: We utilize the collected information for the following specific purposes:
SECTION2.ITEM1: Processing orders, shipping products, and providing live order tracking updates.
SECTION2.ITEM2: Improving store performance and personalizing your experience based on browsing behavior.
SECTION2.ITEM3: Monitoring technical health, security, and user flows through session logs and heatmaps.

SECTION3.TITLE: 3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
SECTION3.TEXT: We utilize cookies to remember your preferences and shopping cart items, and to gather statistical insights on store usage. You can manage or disable cookie preferences anytime through the store consent banner or your browser settings.
SECTION3.CONSENT_INFO: You can modify your cookie preferences at any time using the cookie banner at the bottom of the page.

SECTION4.TITLE: 4. Data Sharing with Third Parties
SECTION4.TEXT: We never sell or rent your personal data to any third party. We only share strictly necessary information with trusted partners required to fulfill our service (such as shipping couriers, secure payment gateways, and certified analytics tools).
SECTION4.TRUST_CARRIERS: Authorized delivery couriers to ship orders across all governorates.
SECTION4.TRUST_PAYMENT: Licensed, PCI-DSS certified electronic payment gateways.
SECTION4.TRUST_ANALYTICS: Certified analytics tools (Google Analytics & Microsoft Clarity) for user experience optimization.

SECTION5.TITLE: 5. Data Protection & Security
SECTION5.TEXT: We apply rigorous industry-standard security and encryption protocols to protect your personal and financial details against unauthorized access.
SECTION5.SECURITY_NOTE: All communication and transactions are fully encrypted via SSL/TLS protocols to ensure maximum security during browsing and checkout.
